core.selectionnez_un_projet_pour_voir: Select a project to see the conditions of each step.
core.aucun_modele_accepte_a_la: No model accepted at validation. Tuning on an unvalidated model is not allowed: identify the process (step 4), then have the model accepted (step 5).
core.repere_de_la_boucle_grandeur: Loop tag, controlled variable, operating point and objective.
core.import_d_un_csv_ou: CSV import or read-only acquisition from the PLC.
core.qualite_temporelle_saturation_excit: Timing quality, saturation, excitation and gaps are checked at import and can be reviewed.

core.choisissez_un_essai_d_identificatio: Choose an identification test and a distinct validation test.
core.modele_s_accepte_s_sur: {0} model(s) accepted on an independent test.
core.les_modeles_identifies_n_ont: The identified models did not pass validation. Review the rejected criteria; a more informative validation test or another model type is needed.
core.choix_de_la_methode_de: Choice of the tuning method (Lambda or SIMC) and of the controller type suited to the accepted model.
core.catalogue_schneider_et_siemens_les: Schneider and Siemens catalogue: prepared values remain “unqualified”.
core.calcul_des_parametres_et_conversion: Parameter calculation and conversion to the structure of the chosen block.
core.simulation_en_boucle_fermee_sensibi: Closed-loop simulation, sensitivity, stability margins, saturation.
core.fiche_d_etude_pdf_les: PDF study sheet. Simulated results are distinguished from measurements.
product.description: Software assisting the engineering of industrial control and servo systems: data acquisition and analysis, process identification, tuning, optimisation and validation of control loops.
product.qualification: Results are theoretical and come from identified models: they must be tried on a test bench or in simulation before any commissioning. ORIAS reads PLCs read-only, never writes to them and is not declared industrially qualified.
margins.w.multi: several 0 dB crossings: read the minimum margin
margins.w.none: no 0 dB crossing: very weak loop activity
